issues.reason: "Where a THING is" pins the position route: a bare position clause mints no event whatever its verb (sit is in the listed postural set), and the four reification triggers — progressive morphology, a manner adverb, a time modifier, a connective endpoint — are all absent here ("right behind" is a degree-modified preposition, "in class" a place), while tense alone is explicitly not a trigger, so sk_sit_1 and its Experiencer/Past atoms are unlicensed.

Same rule's second half: a non-containment preposition takes the entity-attached surface head wrapped by tense — the prompt's own (Past (Against sk_mattock_1 sk_wall_1)) — and "in" is containment, so the position belongs on edmundo as (Past (RightBehind edmundo melissa)) and (Past (LocatedIn edmundo class)), not as obliques on a minted event.

gaps_confirmed: degree modifier on a spatial preposition ("right behind"): the CamelCase multi-word-preposition rule covers "next to" / "across the lane from", but nothing states how an intensifier over a preposition is carried
new_gaps: institutional bare-noun PP "in class": whether such a PP is spatial containment (LocatedIn), a temporal/occasion frame, or a framing/domain PP (preposition-named oblique) is not decided by the instruction set
repair_summary: Removed the unlicensed sit event (e_sit, e_sit_exp, e_sit_tns); re-attached the position to edmundo as (Past (RightBehind edmundo melissa)) and re-routed "in class" to the containment head as (Past (LocatedIn edmundo class)), keeping the two Name atoms and the two surviving proof names unchanged.
notes: RightBehind is kept: joining the surface words into one head is the same licence as AcrossTheLaneFrom, and it asserts nothing false or ill-typed in gap territory.
